parameter_refs.name: declared_purpose
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: left turn onto/from, through travel or right turn

quote: If a highway has been designed to provide a single center lane to be used only for turning by traffic moving in both directions, the following rules apply: A vehicle may be driven in the center turn lane only for the purpose of making a left-hand turn onto or from the highway.

activation.condition: Highway designed with one center turn-only lane for both traffic directions; qualifying vehicle driven there.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Independent pre-entry purpose and observed route are retained separately; sufficiency is for local review, with no invented distance or duration cutoff.
judgment_calls_needed.phrase: only for the purpose of making a left-hand turn onto or from the highway

obligation.description: Center-lane driving only for a left-hand turn onto or from the highway.

timing.description: Preserve independently declared purpose before entry and original occupancy/turn history before, during and after lane use.
